items.title: Multi-Agent Trading System Research Project
items.description: Launched comprehensive research project to build autonomous trading agent capable of generating profit and covering VPS/LLM costs. 10+ parallel research agents covering alpha sources, execution infrastructure, ML trading, alternative markets, backtesting, whale tracking, arbitrage engine, news trading, and trading infrastructure.

items.title: Capital Preservation Requirement
items.description: Project must maintain profitability to afford VPS and LLM model running costs. Cannot afford drawdowns that threaten operation. Safety-first approach with circuit breakers at 2% daily and 5% weekly drawdown limits.

items.title: Self-Hosted Infrastructure Requirement
items.description: User specified system must be self-hosted and manageable by Clawd without expensive SaaS dependencies. Avoid QuickNode ($200/mo), Nansen ($1,200-12K/mo), and other paid APIs. Target: <$100/month total operating costs using local databases, free RPC endpoints, and free data tiers.

items.title: Speed and Automation Priority
items.description: System must identify and execute opportunities faster than human traders. Sub-second arbitrage detection (<100ms detection, <500ms execution), 8-15 second whale copy-trading latency, sub-5 second news reaction. 24/7 automated operation with minimal human intervention.

items.title: APE Funding Rate Arbitrage
items.description: Opportunity: APE funding rate arbitrage offering 104% annualized return. Buy APE spot, short perp futures. $500 minimum capital, generates ~$1.42/day income. Low-risk strategy suitable for initial revenue generation.

items.title: Ethena USDe Yield Opportunity
items.description: Opportunity: Ethena USDe synthetic dollar with 15.2% APY yield on stablecoins. Low-risk passive income opportunity suitable for covering baseline costs. Documented in RESEARCH-OPPORTUNITIES-NOW.md.

items.title: Credit Card/Bank Bonus Arbitrage
items.description: Opportunity: Credit card and bank bonus arbitrage offering $500-1,500 per opportunity with low risk. Steady income source identified as complement to high-frequency trading strategies.

items.title: Research Documents Created
items.description: Multiple research documents created: RESEARCH-POLYMARKET-TRADING.md, RESEARCH-CRYPTO-TRADING.md, RESEARCH-OPPORTUNITIES-NOW.md, DESIGN-WHALETRACKER.md, DESIGN-ARBITRAGE-ENGINE.md, RESEARCH-EXECUTION-INFRA.md, RESEARCH-ALPHA-SOURCES.md, DESIGN-NEWS-TRADING.md, RESEARCH-ML-TRADING.md, DESIGN-TRADING-INFRA.md, RESEARCH-ALTERNATIVE-MARKETS.md, RESEARCH-BACKTESTING-RISK.md.

items.title: ML Model Selection Decision
items.description: Decision: Use simple ML models (Random Forest, XGBoost with 5-7 features) instead of complex deep learning. Reason: Simple models outperform complex ones in production, easier to validate and monitor, no expensive GPU infrastructure needed, aligns with self-hosted requirement.

items.title: Risk and Validation Framework
items.description: Requirement: 4-stage validation pipeline (strategy development, robustness testing, market validation, capital deployment) with paper trading before live deployment. Monte Carlo stress testing (1000+ runs), CVaR for tail risk assessment. No deployment without statistical confidence of profitability.

items.title: Self-Hosted Design In Progress
items.description: Sub-agent currently designing self-hosted version of trading system with <$100/month costs, no QuickNode/Nansen dependencies, local databases, free RPC endpoints, Docker-based deployment. Document will be DESIGN-SELFHOSTED-TRADING.md.

items.title: Pivot to Crypto DEX Trading
items.description: Pivoted from Polymarket trading to crypto DEX trading due to geographic restrictions - Polymarket not available in Thailand (2026-01-31 14:48 UTC). Will use Chainlink price feeds and DEX-based trading approach instead of prediction markets.

items.title: Wallet + DEX Only Approach
items.description: Crypto bot will use wallet + DEXs only, no centralized exchange concerns. DEX trading is globally accessible with no KYC or geographic restrictions (2026-01-31 14:51 UTC).

items.title: Crypto Thailand Plan Creation
items.description: Sub-agent crypto-thailand-plan deployed to create comprehensive plan for crypto trading bot in Thailand using Chainlink repos and existing research (2026-01-31 14:49 UTC). Will output CRYPTO-TRADING-THAILAND-PLAN.md.
